主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. announced a secondary offering of L.P. units of Brookfield Renewable Energy Partners. The filing was submitted to the SEC on March 13, 2013, as part of a Form 6-K report. The company is a major player in the financial services industry, focusing on asset management and investment strategies. The offering is a significant move in the renewable energy sector, highlighting the company's commitment to sustainable investments. The filing also includes incorporation by reference to the Form 6-K dated March 1, 2013, and the exhibit thereto. The report was signed by B. D. Lawson, who holds the title of Managing Partner & CFO.
